scripts.check:extension: node --check extension/background.js && node --check extension/content.js && node --check extension/options.js && node --check extension/popup.js && node --check extension/blocked.js
scripts.check:manifest: node -e "const m=require('./extension/manifest.json');const fs=require('fs');const files=[m.background.service_worker,...m.content_scripts.flatMap(c=>c.js),m.options_ui.page,m.action.default_popup];for(const f of files){if(!fs.existsSync('extension/'+f))throw new Error('manifest references missing file: '+f)}console.log('manifest references '+files.length+' existing files')"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run check:extension && npm run check:manifest && npm run build
